newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Entertainment sets sale of notes.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Entertainment sets sale of notes.

text.p: Hollywood Entertainment Corp said Friday it agreed to sell $200 million aggregate principal amount of 10-5/8 percent senior subordinated notes due 2004 in a private placement.
The company said the price to the initial purchasers of the notes will be 97 percent of the principal amount.

The company said it plans to use the proceeds from the sale to repay the amount outstanding under its revolving credit facility, which was $130.0 million at June 30, and to fund expansion and for working capital and other general corporate purposes.
